segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells microwave ablation medical devices and other medical devices to hospitals and distributors in China.
segments.evidence: The Company's revenue and net income/loss are substantially derived from sales of MWA and other medical devices.

revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from direct customers include revenue from sales of medical devices to hospitals (i.e. directly or through deliverers).
